title: Paul Mellon's family and support for fascism
summary: Steven Greer tells of Paul Mellon's family and support for fascism, about 1930s-1945 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he said, "Yeah, I mean, he was a huge supporter of Adolf Hitler and fascism. So was Henry Ford. So was Watson of IBM.

plain: On the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, a guest named Steven Greer, who talks about hidden UFO secrets, passes on what a man he names told him about a figure called Paul Mellon and his family in the United States, roughly from the 1930s to 1945. According to Greer, this man said Mellon was a huge supporter of Adolf Hitler and fascism, and so were the carmaker Henry Ford and Watson of the computing company IBM. Greer tells it to suggest that powerful American families have a long history of hidden loyalties.
